title: Best {category} of 2026: top {n} by overall score
lead: We rank current models by their specifications against all {category} in our catalogue: each spec gets a percentile score, key specs count double. No paid placements.
method: How the score works: for every spec that matters we check what share of models in the category this one beats (0–100). Key specs have weight 2, others weight 1; the score is the weighted average. Only models with most specs known are ranked. Prices and personal taste are not included — compare the finalists before you buy.
